points.title: 天才少年
points.description: 冯·诺依曼出生于布达佩斯一个富裕的犹太银行家家庭，从小就展现出非凡的智力。他8岁时就能微积分，12岁已精通高等数学和物理。在路德中学期间，他与数学家费凯特合作发表了第一篇数学论文。这段早期教育奠定了他跨学科思维的基础，使他能够在数学、物理和工程学之间自由切换，为他后来的多领域成就埋下伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Budapest to a wealthy Jewish banking family, von Neumann displayed exceptional intelligence from an early age. He mastered calculus by age 8 and was proficient in advanced mathematics and physics by age 12. During his time at Lutheran Gymnasium, he co-authored his first mathematical paper with mathematician László Rátz. This early education established his interdisciplinary thinking foundation, allowing him to freely move between mathematics, physics, and engineering, laying the groundwork for his later multi-field achievements.

points.title: 学术奠基
points.description: 冯·诺依曼同时在布达佩斯大学、柏林大学和苏黎世联邦理工学院学习化学和数学，同时在布达佩斯大学获得博士学位。他在这一时期发表了集合论、测度论和算子理论的重要论文，建立了冯·诺依曼代数理论。他还提出了博弈论的公理化基础，为这一学科奠定了数学基础。这段学术训练使他成为20世纪最重要的数学家之一，同时也培养了他解决复杂问题的系统性思维方式。
points.descriptionEn: Von Neumann studied chemistry and mathematics simultaneously at universities in Budapest, Berlin, and ETH Zurich, earning his doctorate from the University of Budapest. During this period, he published groundbreaking papers on set theory, measure theory, and operator theory, establishing von Neumann algebra theory. He also axiomatized game theory, providing the mathematical foundation for this field. This academic training made him one of the most important mathematicians of the 20th century while developing his systematic approach to solving complex problems.

points.title: 欧洲学术巅峰
points.description: 冯·诺依曼在柏林大学担任无薪讲师，同时在汉堡大学兼职教学。他继续在纯数学领域做出重要贡献，包括量子力学的数学基础。他提出了量子力学的公理化表述，将希尔伯特空间算子理论应用于量子系统。这一时期，他成为欧洲数学界的核心人物，与当时最杰出的数学家如希尔伯特、外尔等人密切合作。然而，随着纳粹在德国的崛起，他的犹太背景使他面临日益增长的威胁，迫使他开始考虑离开欧洲。
points.descriptionEn: Von Neumann served as a Privatdozent at the University of Berlin while also teaching at the University of Hamburg. He continued making significant contributions to pure mathematics, including the mathematical foundations of quantum mechanics. He developed an axiomatic formulation of quantum mechanics, applying Hilbert space operator theory to quantum systems. During this period, he became a central figure in European mathematics, closely collaborating with leading mathematicians such as Hilbert and Weyl. However, with the rise of Nazism in Germany, his Jewish background made him face increasing threats, forcing him to consider leaving Europe.

points.title: 美国学术中心
points.description: 冯·诺依曼受邀加入普林斯顿高等研究院，成为首批六位教授之一。在这里，他与爱因斯坦、哥德尔等科学巨匠共同工作。他继续发展量子力学理论，提出了冯·诺依曼架构，奠定了现代计算机科学的基础。在二战期间，他参与了曼哈顿计划，为原子弹的设计做出了关键贡献。战后，他转向计算机科学，设计了EDVAC计算机，提出了存储程序概念，彻底改变了计算技术。这一时期，他成为美国科学界的核心人物，对多个领域产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Von Neumann was invited to join the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton as one of its first six professors. There, he worked alongside scientific giants such as Einstein and Gödel. He continued developing quantum theory and proposed the von Neumann architecture, laying the foundation of modern computer science. During World War II, he contributed to the Manhattan Project, making key contributions to atomic bomb design. After the war, he shifted to computer science, designing the EDVAC computer and proposing the stored-program concept, revolutionizing computing technology. During this period, he became a central figure in American science, exerting profound influence on multiple fields.

points.title: 晚年贡献
points.description: 冯·诺依曼被任命为美国原子能委员会总顾问，继续在政府科学政策中发挥重要作用。尽管被诊断出癌症，他仍然保持惊人的工作强度，完成了自动机理论和细胞自动机的研究，为复杂系统科学和人工智能奠定了基础。他提出了自复制自动机的概念，预见了人工生命研究的可能性。在生命最后阶段，他仍在思考复杂系统的数学模型，试图将计算机科学、生物学和数学统一起来。他的这些晚期工作影响了几代科学家，成为复杂系统研究的先驱。
points.descriptionEn: Von Neumann was appointed as a commissioner of the U.S. Atomic Energy Commission, continuing to play an important role in government science policy. Despite being diagnosed with cancer, he maintained an astonishing work pace, completing research on automata theory and cellular automata, laying the foundation for complex systems science and artificial intelligence. He proposed the concept of self-reproducing automata, foreseeing possibilities in artificial life research. In his final stages, he continued thinking about mathematical models of complex systems, attempting to unify computer science, biology, and mathematics. These late works influenced generations of scientists, making him a pioneer in complex systems research.

appraisal.zh: 冯·诺依曼被公认为20世纪智力最卓越的人物之一，常被称作计算机之父，其贡献横跨数学、物理、计算机科学与经济学，既为量子力学提供了严格的数学框架，也开创了博弈论并奠定了现代计算机的架构基础。另一种看法认为，他在曼哈顿计划中的角色使他部分承担了核武器扩散的责任，对计算军事应用的强调引发伦理争议，其风格有时也被指过于抽象、疏于科学的社会责任。
appraisal.en: Von Neumann is widely regarded as one of the most brilliant minds of the 20th century and is often called the father of computing; his work spanned mathematics, physics, computer science and economics, providing a rigorous mathematical framework for quantum mechanics while pioneering game theory and laying the architectural foundations of the modern computer. Another view holds that his role in the Manhattan Project leaves him partly responsible for nuclear proliferation, that his emphasis on military computing raises ethical concerns, and that his style was sometimes overly abstract and neglectful of science's social responsibility.

supporter.zh: 冯·诺依曼是20世纪最杰出的天才之一，他的贡献跨越数学、物理、计算机科学和经济学等多个领域。他不仅建立了现代计算机的架构基础，还开创了博弈论这一重要学科。他的工作为量子力学提供了严格的数学框架，并在原子能发展中发挥了关键作用。冯·诺依曼代表了科学思维的巅峰，他的跨学科能力和解决复杂问题的方法至今仍激励着无数科学家。
supporter.en: Von Neumann stands as one of the greatest geniuses of the 20th century, whose contributions spanned mathematics, physics, computer science, and economics. He not only established the architectural foundation of modern computing but also pioneered game theory as a vital discipline. His work provided rigorous mathematical frameworks for quantum mechanics and played crucial roles in atomic energy development. Von Neumann represents the pinnacle of scientific thinking, and his interdisciplinary approach and problem-solving methods continue to inspire countless scientists today.

critic.zh: 批评者指出冯·诺依曼在曼哈顿计划中的角色使他对核武器的扩散负有部分责任。他早期对计算机军事应用的强调也引发伦理争议。此外，他的工作风格有时被视为过于抽象，缺乏对实际应用的足够关注。一些评论家认为他过于关注理论而忽视了科学的社会责任，特别是在核武器和自动化武器系统方面的贡献。他的个人生活也被批评为过于自我中心，缺乏对家庭和社会的投入。
critic.en: Critics note von Neumann's role in the Manhattan Project places partial responsibility on him for nuclear weapons proliferation. His early emphasis on military applications of computing also raised ethical concerns. Additionally, his working style was sometimes seen as overly abstract, lacking sufficient attention to practical applications. Some commentators argue he focused too much on theory while neglecting social responsibility of science, particularly regarding his contributions to nuclear weapons and automated weapon systems. His personal life was also criticized as overly self-centered, lacking investment in family and society.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，冯·诺依曼常被描绘为'最后的通才'和'计算机之父'。他的形象超越了单纯的科学家，成为智力卓越的象征。他的生平故事被用来探讨天才的本质、科学与社会的关系以及冷战时期科学家的角色。他的名言'在数学中，你不懂就不懂，你无法假装'反映了数学思维的严谨性。他的遗产不仅体现在具体的技术贡献上，更在于他开创的跨学科研究方法和思维方式，影响了整个20世纪后半叶的科学发展方向。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, von Neumann is often depicted as 'the last polymath' and 'the father of computing.' His image transcends that of a mere scientist, becoming a symbol of intellectual excellence. His life story is used to explore the nature of genius, the relationship between science and society, and the role of scientists during the Cold War. His famous quote 'In mathematics, you don't understand things. You just get used to them' reflects the rigor of mathematical thinking. His legacy is not only evident in specific technical contributions but also in the interdisciplinary research methods and ways of thinking he pioneered, influencing the direction of scientific development throughout the latter half of the 20th century.

self.zh: 在数学中，你不懂就不懂，你无法假装。
self.en: In mathematics, you don't understand things. You just get used to them.
